fields.label: Auto Submit Payment Entry on PDC Conversion
fields.description: If enabled, the conversion tool will submit the created Payment Entry automatically; otherwise it will remain Draft.

fields.label: Service Item Account Mandatory
fields.description: Enforce expense or income account selection for non-stock, non-asset items

fields.label: Use Markup Percentage for Commission Slabs
Sales Partner Comssion %
fields.description: Apply this percentage on total sales team commission to calculate sales partner commission

fields.label: Enable Project Wise Commission
fields.description: Override salesperson commission using project BOQ value slabs

fields.label: Enable Provisional Purchase Order
fields.description: Allow open PO workflow: estimated qty on PO, actual qty on Purchase Receipt, optional auto-sync of PO qty to received qty.

fields.label: Auto Sync PO Qty on Receipt
fields.description: When a receipt exceeds PO qty, increase PO qty to match received qty. PO estimate qty is kept so multiple Purchase Receipts can be created.

fields.label: Default Provisional PO for Non Stock
fields.description: New non-stock Purchase Orders are marked as Provisional / Open PO by default.

fields.label: Restrict Non Stockable Item Users
fields.description: Users listed here can only view and create non-stock Purchase Orders (Is Non Stock).

fields.label: Allow Any Account on Purchase Invoice Expense Head
fields.description: When enabled, users can select any non-group account for the company on PI item Expense Head (Asset, Liability, Equity, Income, or Expense).

fields.label: Include Against Account Entries in GL
fields.description: When an account is filtered in General Ledger, also show other debit/credit lines from the same voucher (e.g. Trade Payable with Retention Payables on the same Purchase Invoice).

fields.label: Group Payments With Against Invoice in GL
fields.description: When party filters are used, sort payment entries with their against invoice in General Ledger reports.

fields.label: Allow Party on Current Asset
fields.description: If enabled, party type and party validations will be bypassed for Current Asset account types, permitting party mapping on them.
